data.long_meaning: The name Benu is derived from the Sanskrit word ‘Benu’, meaning ‘born of a lotus’. It is the name of the celestial goose that holds the sacred scripture, Vedas, in its heart. This name is believed to bestow upon the child a pure and pious soul, just like the lotus flower.
